decisions.rationale: 2025 NOA ($151,017) and paystub (~$148,165 annualized, YTD consistent) are within about 3% of the stated $153,000, which is not a material shortfall.

Balance of $108,621 with history since June covers the $72,800 down payment and closing costs even without the $5,880 e-transfer, which is explained by a bill of sale (its date of Sept 21 postdates the Aug 15 deposit).
Evalu-Rapide Plus is not on the approved appraiser panel, so the appraisal is not acceptable despite supporting value.
No employment letter is on file (borrower note says it is pending), and a paystub does not replace the required letter.
